messages:
anya: quick design huddle 1 - picklist + SLO badges + burst copy. uploaded a tiny prototype: https://figma.com/file/mini

jess: quick read. my main concern: the picklist is long and same-weight items hide common pools. can we add a 3-button quick row for 'Recommended' picks?

sofi: yes please. small icons only on mobile. make sure they have accessible labels (not just color).

mike: backend can surface a preferredPools array in the response. low risk. will add analytics events: ui.pool.quickpick.select

anya: badge idea: show a micro SLO pill on the selected pool chip like "Low-latency" + tiny icon. keeps it human-friendly vs ms numbers.

omar: a11y: pills need aria-labels, and contrast must be >=4.5:1. don't use color alone. also add text fallback for assistive tech.

jess: copy on burst: users ask if burst costs extra. change label to "Burst capacity (time-limited)" and tooltip: "Temporary extra GPUs during spikes; billed at standard rates." Link to pricing.

lee: can we shorten for tight layouts to "Burst (time-limited)" and keep the full sentence in the tooltip?

khalid: keyboard + screen reader notes: slider must have stepper fallback and announce preset and cost bucket via aria-live, e.g., "Latency target: Balanced. Cost: Medium." Keep it concise.

anya: clamp behavior: if Min > poolMax show inline message and SR announcement: "Min adjusted to pool max 4." Short and clear.

mike: one constraint: some pool caps are in a separate service; client should cache caps for 2 mins to avoid extra calls. I'll add to the API ticket.

sofi: UI nit: ensure focus rings remain visible on quick picks in compact mode. mobile long-press shows label.

jess: i'll iterate frames tonight with quick row, SLO pill, updated burst microcopy and keyboard help text. posting follow-up tomorrow.

anya: thanks all 1 :thumbsup: will draft rollout notes and a canary flag.
